```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
patients <- read.csv("../../data/patients.csv")
```

# Summaries

## Continuous variables

```{r}
#| echo: true
summary(patients$sbp)
```

## Categorical variables

```{r}
#| echo: true
table(patients$treatment, patients$readmitted)
```

# Figures

## Blood pressure by treatment

```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
ggplot(patients, aes(treatment, sbp, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#055F56", "#0B376C")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Systolic BP (mmHg)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
```
